bigGame.text: No hunting from 1 hour after sunset to 1 hour before sunrise. Applies to big game and upland birds (all wildlife except migratory game birds).

migratory.text: Ducks and geese: half an hour before sunrise to half an hour after sunset (south of 60 degrees north).

items.label: Hunter number
items.value: Now called FWID (Fish and Wildlife ID), 9 digits. Old hunter number plus 3 digits at the front. No physical card.
items.source: BC Fish and Wildlife ID page (search extract)

items.label: What to carry
items.value: Photo ID. Know your FWID number. All paper species licences for the year (used and unused). Federal bird permit (paper or phone) for ducks and geese.
items.source: BC hunting FAQ; ECCC permit page (search extracts)

items.label: Resident hunting licence
items.value: $25 + $7 surcharge. Electronic only. Bought in WILD online or at Service BC / FrontCounter BC.

items.label: Buying species licences
items.value: Cannot be printed at home. Online orders are mailed (about 14 days). Hunting soon: buy in person.

items.label: Waiting period after buying
items.note: A 2 day waiting period exists for some species. Does it cover deer? VERIFY.

items.label: Quail and grouse licence (residents)
items.value: No species licence. BC hunting licence only.

items.label: Federal Migratory Game Bird Hunting Permit
items.value: $17 + tax, stamp included. 2026 e permit valid 1 Aug 2026 to 30 Jun 2027. Buy online, carry on phone or paper.

items.label: Duck and goose seasons near Kamloops
items.note: VERIFY from ECCC BC summary 2026 to 2027.

items.label: Shooting near buildings
items.value: No hunting or shooting within 100 m of a church, school, playground, regional park, or a dwelling house or farm or ranch building occupied by people or domestic animals. The owner exemption covers slaughtering livestock only, not hunting.
items.source: BC synopsis 2026 to 2028 and B.C. Reg. 190/84 (search preview)

items.label: Unlicensed companion
items.value: May come along and watch, and help pack meat out, if not carrying a firearm or weapon and not hunting. Licensed hunter must stay with the meat unless a transport record is filled in.
items.source: BC hunting FAQ; Wildlife Act s.1 (search extracts)

items.label: Region 3 deer bag limit
items.note: Search extract says 3 combined (1 mule deer, 2 white tailed). VERIFY in Region 3 synopsis.

items.label: MU (Management Unit) for Heffley Creek and Sun Peaks
Region 8 California quail
items.value: 1 Oct to 30 Nov. Daily bag 10, possession 30. MUs 8-1 to 8-15 and 8-21 to 8-26.

items.label: Region 3 California quail
items.note: Is there a season near Heffley Creek? VERIFY.

items.label: BC Firearm Violence Prevention Act
items.value: In force 1 October 2026. Offences include transporting loaded firearms in a vehicle and shooting from vehicles and boats. Hunting exemptions come by regulation.
